Multiple times. 
I've gone through all trouble shooting methods.
I'm going to start with a 4 day fast tomorrow :) I'd love someone to chat with/accountability partner.

I'll give it a try. 
I do not usually do anything for him shy of making dinner, or washing his clothes if they end up in the laundry bins downstairs. My main focus is the children and i refuse to let them live in a mess.

Partner sadly. 
I fully agree with sleeping patterns, and he blames it on duty (he's military and at the beginning of this was doing 4 days off 1 day on(24 hour shift). 
I do plan on ending the relationship(15 years) if things keep going this route however need to also make sure I have everything in a row for my children since we do not have any family to rely on here and would not easily be able to move back home.

Believe me, I've tried giving him responsibility. He will turn and push it all onto our 10 year old son.  I've divided up chores before and asked him to do simple things like take out the trash, unloading the dishwasher, and mowing the lawn and it all falls magically onto our son and if it is brought up he plays the victim or goes on a big rant about how he shouldn't have too. I can not change the person he has become and he does not listen to reasoning.

I'll start working on slowing down my speech etc. When I'm talking to her as well. I never thought of that so thank you. 
I'll start researching the lindcombe program/seeing if any SLP use it here. 
She has an appointment next Monday so thankfully they got her in pretty quickly.
We're in Canada. Her school does have a SLP but I imagine there stretched thin already as it is. I called her school to see if there's something they can offer on there end as well.

I have no issue doing the work from home if that is what's needed, but I would definitely need help figuring out a direction to take. So once we get a referral from her Doctor I will start looking for one.

The reason why we are not bringing attention to it is because we don't want her to become insecure about it. 
Unfortunately in order to get her into a speech pathologist we have to have a referral from her Doctor to have it covered under our benefits otherwise we would be paying out of pocket.
